name: job_output
description: Read a command, PTY or agent activation result. Output cursors are independent. Optional waiting ends on settlement, deadline or human steering without stopping the producer. A successful committed terminal result acknowledges its completion notice; cancelled reads do not.

job_id.description: Activation or resource ID returned by subagent, shell execution, list_agents or job_list.

cursor.description: Independent process-output cursor; does not apply to agent result snapshots.

wait.description: Wait for settlement, user steering or the configured deadline. Waiting never cancels the producer.

timeout_ms.description: Wait bound in milliseconds. Set null with wait:true to reserve the configured maximum for one event-driven completion wait instead of repeated short reads. Omission uses the configured default; numeric values are clamped to the jobs maximum. Human steering and cancellation still end the read.

sources.Description: Session-owned command, PTY and agent activation control.
